@@U03947@@
we Dryads, spirits of trees, lure lightly, teasing, coaxing the springs of life to rise from roots into trembling twigs. Then we deck them out with leaves, lavish them with lovely blossoms, adorning our hair for prosperous growth. And when the ripe fruit falls, they'll gather, folks and flocks, to reap and nibble, pressing on in eager masses, everyone bowed down to earth, as once they bowed to ancient gods.

@@U03949@@
Mountain nymphs, Oreads are we, who cling here, gently caressing, close to smooth-polished rocks that reflect afar. We will hearken, we will listen for every sound, for songs of birds, for fluting reeds, even for Great Pan's fearsome shout: for every one we have an answer always ready. To a rustling wind we rustle back; to the thunder’s clap we clap, and again, and again and again till we're all clapped out.

@@U03951@@
Sisters, Naiads, water spirits, we, more lively-minded than they, will wander on with swiftly flowing brooks that lure us to well-wooded hills. Ever downward, ever deeper, we will water now the meadows, next the pastures, then, ah, then, the lovely gardens that circle the houses. We'll know the place by the slender line of cypresses that tower above the landscape, shore, and mirroring sea.
translation:
@@U03947@@
我们树精，树精，轻轻地引诱、戏弄、哄骗生命之泉从根部长成颤抖的树枝。然后我们用树叶装饰它们，用可爱的花朵装饰它们，装饰我们的头发，使其蓬勃发展。当成熟的果实落下时，人们和羊群就会聚集在一起，去收割和啃食，成群结队地向前推进，每个人都向大地鞠躬，就像向远古诸神鞠躬一样。

@@U03949@@
山中的仙女，奥瑞德就是我们，我们紧贴在这里，轻轻地爱抚着，靠近远处反射的光滑抛光的岩石。我们会倾听，我们会倾听每一种声音，鸟儿的歌声，芦苇的笛声，甚至是大潘神的可怕叫喊：对于每一种声音，我们都准备好了答案。伴随着沙沙的风，我们沙沙作响；随着雷声的响起，我们鼓掌，一次又一次，一次又一次，直到我们都拍完为止。

@@U03951@@
姐妹们，水仙，水精灵，我们，比她们更活泼，将沿着湍急的溪流漫步，引诱我们到树木茂盛的山丘。一直向下，越来越深，我们现在将浇灌草地，接下来是牧场，然后，啊，然后，浇灌房屋周围的美丽花园。我们可以通过一排细长的柏树来认识这个地方，这些柏树高耸于风景、海岸和如镜的大海之上。
